# Secrets

Two callouts, one in each state. The marker byte is the whole edit: `-` is a
secret hidden from everybody but the GM, and `+` is public.

> [!secret]- The GM's note   ^first
> The vault's second entrance is behind the mill, and the miller knows it.

> [!secret]+ What the party has already been told
> The eastern signal fire was replaced three nights ago.

## Why both

A demo showing only the collapsed state demonstrates a page that is missing, and a
demo showing only the revealed state demonstrates a page with nothing to hide. The
reveal is one byte in the file; `make demo-check` requires one of each.
